brief:
Israeli forces bombed the roof of Al-Daraj School in central Gaza City early Thursday, seriously injuring a Palestinian, according to IMEMC News citing a Wafa news correspondent. The school houses displaced people seeking shelter from the conflict.

No additional details were available about the extent of damage or the number of people sheltering at the facility at the time of the strike.
